title: ACDP Change Hint (0.5.0, Draft)
description: acdp-change-hint/1: webhook body telling a subscriber that new matching entries exist; carries no change content (RFC-ACDP-0018 §8.2). Authenticated by the ACDP-Signature HMAC header, which conveys no producer or registry authenticity. The receiver pulls GET /changes from its OWN persisted cursor; head_cursor is informational.
